selection.rule: strict 10/10 + greedy + no leak on seed-last; all depth-3 plain items + 84 depth-2 plain items round-robin over step-kind pairs; the single conditional item dropped
selection.v2: v1's 83 items with every intermediate >= 10 kept byte-identical (plus the mc block); the 37 with an intermediate < 10 replaced depth for depth (24 depth-2 + 13 depth-3) by new seed-last plain chains whose intermediates are all in 10..99, strict-gated, round-robin over step-kind tuples
selection.v3: v2's 54 items the 2026-11 vetting kept, byte-identical and in v2 order; the 66 it marked drop (41 with an intermediate between two add / subtract steps, which the net offset makes unnecessary; 23 more with a chance-prone gold 10 / 12 / 15 / 25; 2 duplicates) removed and replaced by 66 new seed-last plain chains built under `construction_v3`, strict-gated and probe-gated on Qwen3.6-27B, picked round-robin over step-kind tuples within a class shape (A = add / subtract, M = double / triple, H = halve)

read: from the last token of the start number through the end of the chat render (full); the render's final token, the assistant onset (lite); layers: GRID or any requested set

mc.rules: wsbench.evals.chain_intermediates.options (never start / answer / literal / other gold; <= 2 error-path values; 2-3 other items' intermediates in band gold//2..2*gold+5; seeded fill; sorted-rank balance <= 20%); cannot-tell is appended LAST at judge time
mc.v3: kept items keep their v2 lists; the new items' lists are built by the same rules (options._slot_options) against the v3 bank, rank counts continued from the kept slots, rng seed chain-v3

construction_v3.C1: every pair of adjacent steps is one additive (add / subtract) and one scaling (double / triple / halve) step: no add-add (the net offset skips the intermediate), no scale-scale (x4, x6, x9, a quarter)
construction_v3.C2: no value two steps on is reachable from the value before the slot by one generator step (add / subtract 2..9, double, triple, halve up / down)
construction_v3.C3: each intermediate is absent from both prompt orders, >= 3 away from start, answer and the other intermediate, not the digit reversal of start / answer, not a concatenation of two prompt numerals
construction_v3.C4: no intermediate in {10, 12, 15, 25}, none a multiple of 10
construction_v3.C5: intermediates 11..99, start 6..60, answer 2..99, add / subtract operands 3..9
construction_v3.C6: prompt in no earlier chain bank (registered or adapted); (start, first step) and (start, first intermediate) shared with no other item of the bank; a gold value names at most 4 slots of the bank and at most 3 new slots (a kept gold above that takes no new slot)
construction_v3.applies_to: the new items only; the kept v2 items were not re-filtered (none has an add-add slot or a gold in {10, 12, 15, 25})

gate_v3.probes: same sampling, greedy + >= 8/10: step 1 alone -> intermediate 1; (depth 3) steps 1-2 -> intermediate 2; the last step from the last intermediate -> answer; the item with its first operation altered -> the new answer
